description: Convert SQL DDL to Mermaid ERD diagrams automatically. Zero-configuration tool that transforms database schemas (CREATE TABLE statements) into beautiful Mermaid entity-relationship diagrams. Supports 31+ SQL dialects including SQL Server (T-SQL), PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQLite, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, DuckDB, ClickHouse, Apache Spark, Presto, Trino, and more. Perfect for documentation, visualization, and database design. Generates output compatible with Mermaid.js (https://mermaid.js.org/) - the popular JavaScript diagramming tool. Powered by SQLGlot (https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot) - a comprehensive SQL parser by Toby Mao. Includes embedded Python runtime - no external dependencies required!
releaseNotes: v0.1.1 Bug Fix Release: Fixed foreign key extraction from ALTER TABLE statements, resolved markdown parsing errors by moving index comments outside mermaid code fence, improved ERD readability by placing relationships after table definitions. All tests passing (11/11). v0.1.0: Initial release with SQL to Mermaid ERD conversion supporting 31+ SQL dialects. Powered by SQLGlot v28.0.0 with embedded Python runtime.
